title: Recover arena-manager group C (CI/Rust tuning) without weakening any gate
problem: arena-manager commits 50231cc0..c072ff27 (group C of the DEC-0008 audit) tune CI and Rust builds. Review found: Level 2 reduced from cargo test --workspace to 5 of 8 crates; runs-on reduced to [self-hosted, linux] (violates RUNNER-PROTOCOL label sets); cargo nextest not provisioned on main runners; clean:false on persistent self-hosted runners; cancel-in-progress would also cancel main push runs used as merge evidence; audit fetch-depth 2 drops origin/main needed by --base; split-debuginfo=unpacked unsupported on windows-msvc; codegen-units=8 contradicts its own rationale (dev default is 256).

options.summary: Recover the safe subset and correct the unsafe items so no test set shrinks

rationale: Recovered: UTF-8 BOM removal; bash/python3 on Linux runners with full protocol labels [self-hosted, linux, x64, rust-build, n8n-rust]; paths-ignore for docs/markdown/logs; concurrency groups with cancel-in-progress on pull_request only; shallow checkouts where history is unused; Level 0 fmt+check split from Level 1; Level 2 conformance split into its own job; Level 1 affected-crate tests that always include the previous default (n8n-workflow) and escalate to the workspace for Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock/n8n-common changes; Level 2 cargo test --workspace on both Linux and Windows (coverage increases); dev/test profiles debug=1 and dependency opt-level=2. Rejected/corrected: 5-crate subset, bare [self-hosted, linux], nextest, clean:false, main-run cancellation, audit fetch-depth 2, split-debuginfo, codegen-units=8, the validation push trigger on arena-manager (it becomes Manager memory, TASK-0008). The rustfmt commit 83b95552 is already on main. Cargo.toml keeps its existing CRLF line endings (the audit note about CRLF was a misreading: the file is CRLF on main). Performance effects are not claimed; none were measured.
